mlm:name: OlmoEarth
description: OlmoEarth (Ai2) is a family of spatio-temporal, multimodal ViT encoder-decoder foundation models (Nano/Tiny/Base/Large, 1.4M-300M encoder parameters) for Earth observation. It takes aligned monthly time series (up to 12 timesteps over one year) of Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1 and Landsat imagery resampled to 10 m, tokenised per bandset with a variable patch size, and is pretrained with 'Latent MIM Lite' (masked tokens predicted in the latent space of a frozen random projection) plus patch-discrimination and instance-contrastive losses; six derived maps are decode-only targets, so inference needs only satellite imagery. Against 12 other foundation models it was best on 15/24 kNN/linear-probe and 19/29 fine-tuning tasks, including partner tasks such as mangrove, crop-type and vessel mapping. This record describes v1 (2025-11-04); later versions are v1.1 (arXiv 2605.20804), v1.2 and v1.3 (2026-10-22, a new model that produces the OlmoEarth v1.3 precomputed embeddings).
mlm:architecture: Vision Transformer (ViT encoder-decoder (decoder depth 4, same width/heads as encoder). Encoder sizes: ViT-Nano (depth 4, dim 128, 8 heads, 1.4M), ViT-Tiny (12, 192, 3 heads, 6.2M), ViT-Base (12, 768, 12 heads, 90M), ViT-Large (24, 1024, 16 heads, 300M). The HF model cards list Base at 89M and Large at 308M encoder params.)
pretext_training_type: Masked latent prediction (Latent MIM Lite: predicting frozen random-projection token targets) with contrastive losses
masking_strategy: Modality-aware masking: for each example, each bandset is randomly assigned not-selected, encode-only (random token masking), decode-only (full bandset reconstructed as target), or encode-and-decode (randomly masked, masked tokens are targets). Derived maps are never encoded, only decode-only or not selected. The paper gives no ratio; the official v1 config uses strategy 'modality_cross_random' with encode_ratio 0.5 and decode_ratio 0.5.
pretraining: Latent MIM Lite. Targets come from a randomly initialised, frozen linear projection per modality, mapping masked patches into token space. This replaces Latent MIM's learned or EMA target encoder and avoids representation collapse. A depth-4 decoder with learned MASK tokens cross-attends to visible encoder tokens and predicts the latents of masked tokens. Loss 1 is modality patch discrimination: cosine similarity plus cross-entropy, contrasting each prediction only against target tokens from the same bandset/modality to remove easy negatives (tau 0.1 in the official config). Loss 2 is an instance contrastive loss (SimCLR/InfoNCE-style) on average-pooled encoder outputs of two different random maskings of the same input, weighted 0.1, applied within 32-example micro-batches. Observations and six derived maps (WorldCover, WorldCereal, CDL, OpenStreetMap raster, SRTM, canopy height) go through the same frozen-projection/loss path, which unifies self- and weakly-supervised learning; maps are targets only. Training is 667,200 steps (about 100B tokens) on H100s (Nano/Tiny/Base) and B200s (Large; 5,240 GPU-hours). Ablations show the frozen-projection targets, modality masking, per-modality patch discrimination, the contrastive loss and the maps each improve results.
domain_knowledge: Bandset tokenisation: bands grouped by native resolution (S2: 10 m / 20 m / 60 m groups; Landsat: 15 m pan / 30 m groups)
Sinusoidal temporal embedding over monthly timesteps (the repo code also adds a fixed month-of-year encoding)
Weak supervision from derived EO maps (WorldCover, WorldCereal, USDA CDL, OpenStreetMap, SRTM, Meta/WRI canopy height) as decode-only targets
Geographic sampling by 120 OpenStreetMap feature categories (up to 10,000 tiles each)
Per-modality contrastive negatives (contrast only within the same bandset)
Variable patch size to trade off spatial resolution and compute
backbone_modifications: FlexiViT-style variable patch embedding (patch size 1-8), implemented by resizing input instead of resizing weights
Separate patch embedding per bandset (S2 split into 3, Landsat into 2, S1 VV/VH one)
Full joint self-attention across space, time and modalities in the encoder
Lightweight depth-4 cross-attention decoder for latent prediction
Average-pooled tokens over modalities, timesteps and locations as the global embedding (no CLS token)
spatial_resolution: 10m (all inputs resampled to 10 m/pixel; lower-resolution bandsets tokenised at coarser internal resolution)
temporal_resolution: monthly (up to 12 timesteps over one year; 3-12 used in training; single images supported)

mlm:input.name: Sentinel-2 L2A
mlm:input.description: Three bandsets by native resolution: 10 m (B02, B03, B04, B08), 20 m (B05, B06, B07, B8A, B11, B12), 60 m (B01, B09)

mlm:input.name: Landsat 8/9
mlm:input.description: Two bandsets: pan (B8) and 30 m (B1-B7, B9-B11)

mlm:pretrained_source: OlmoEarth pretraining dataset (allenai/olmoearth_pretrain_dataset): Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, Landsat-8 observations plus WorldCereal, ESA WorldCover, USDA CDL, OpenStreetMap, SRTM and canopy height maps Acquisition period: 2016-2024 (each sample covers a one-year window starting uniformly between Jan 2016 and Dec 2024)
sampling: Enumerate all 2.56 km tiles containing each of 120 OpenStreetMap feature categories (roads to geothermal power plants) and randomly sample up to 10,000 tiles per category, giving 285,288 samples
processing:level: Sentinel-2 L2A; Sentinel-1 RTC; Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 L1 (per the repo dataset-creation configs; not stated in the paper)
processing:lineage: All modalities resampled to 10 m/pixel; Up to 12 monthly timesteps per one-year sample; Bands grouped into bandsets by native resolution
missing_data: Many samples contain only a subset of timesteps and modalities; missing ones are simply absent (not selected) in masking/tokenisation

mlm:hyperparameters.patch_size: variable 1-8 px per bandset (random per batch in training); 4x4 default at evaluation
mlm:hyperparameters.learning_rate: AdamW, base LR 1e-4, weight decay 0.02, linear warmup 8,000 steps then cosine annealing to 0.1x over 667,200 total steps
augmentations: Random square spatial crop (1-12 tokens per side)
Two independent random maskings per sample (views for instance contrastive loss)
mlm:hyperparameters.image_resolution: 2.56 km x 2.56 km tiles (256x256 at 10 m); random square crops of 1-12 tokens per side (max 96x96 px at patch size 8); 3-12 monthly timesteps
